subject: Taxes
title: The Future of Tax Psychology
description: Learn The Future of Tax Psychology in one minute.

hook.text: Behavioral insights have already recovered billions in unpaid taxes worldwide.

buildup.text: Different people respond to different motivators. Some react to social norms, others to fear, others to moral appeals.

discovery.text: AI can analyze taxpayer profiles and choose the most effective nudge: a reminder for the forgetful.

twist.text: But personalized government persuasion raises ethical questions.

climax.text: Tax psychology is the future of revenue collection.

punchline.text: AI nudges, personalized and powerful. The ethical line is still being drawn.

quiz.question: What ethical concern does AI-personalized tax nudging raise?
options: It could cross the line from helpful nudge to surveillance-powered manipulation
It only works in wealthy countries
